answer: A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The violet counter is kept in sable and raven shows each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4480 identities would post 2738 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
